_meta.time: glTF seconds = frame / 24 (frame 0 = rest, every node at its rest or parked pose)
_meta.usage: one AnimationClip; cut sub-ranges with THREE.AnimationUtils.subclip(clip, name, start, end, 24) and keep only the tracks of the clip's 'nodes' (every other node is static or parked inside the range). Ranges end on a held pose; 'off' = play the same range reversed.
_meta.morph: Film_Shield carries one morph target 'Extend' (weight 0 = rolled up in the slot, 1 = 100 mm out); its weights track is part of take_photo / shield_eject / print_out

take_photo.what: shutter press 1.2 mm (f1-10), motor eject of the print 113.9 mm under the film shield (f14-56, 4-frame ramps), settle (f57-62)

shield_eject.what: the eject part of take_photo only: print + shield, for scroll scrubbing

print_out.what: the print drawn 30 mm out while the shield springs back into the slot (reset to rest by f83, outside the range)

filter_starburst_on.what: fly in, stop 4.5 mm out, turn -25 to 0 deg until the notch meets the light meter, push home, click (0.35 mm rebound)

filter_orange_on.what: fly in, press straight home, click

filter_yellow_on.what: fly in, press straight home, click

filter_blue_on.what: fly in, press straight home, click

lens_cover_on.what: fly in, press straight home, click

lens_explode.what: 0 = assembled, end = separated along the optical axis: light meter forward and down, front glass -40 mm, rear glass -30, text ring -22, stepped bezel -12; the barrel (filter mount) stays

body_explode.what: 0 = assembled, end = exploded: rear shell +40 mm back, front shell up and forward, film door down and forward, lens forward, flash and viewfinder parts out of their pockets, film pack stays in the middle

door_open.what: the film door drops open 90 deg on its rear-bottom hinge (with a 2.5 deg overshoot), showing the film pack in the chamber
